text: Read the brief Case Study and answer the questions that follow: Flipkart is a Bangalore — based firm that operates in the e-commerce domain. It was set up in September 2007 as an online book retailing venture with the objective of making books accessible to customers anywhere in India, at competitive prices, through excellent customer service and prompt delivery. There is fierce competition in the e- commerce segment with many strong players, such as Amazon.in and Snapdeal.com; however, Flipkart has retained its market share and dominance. The experience of buying a product, say a book, at the Flipkart website is similar to doing transactions on other online storés. Upon arriving at the site, a customer is presented with an array of options for purchase. In 2016 Flipkart offered seven broad categories to choose from — electronics, appliances, furniture, books, and products specific to men, women, and children (such as clothes or toys). When the books menu is selected, the site shows books that are currently popular or have been just released. The customer can search for a book by typing in the title or the name of the author in a search text box. The result of the search displays a number of books with similar titles or books by the same author. The customer can also browse the website by subject and see a list of books on

subject: Information System Management
text: particular subject. If the customer decides to buy a book then he/ she can select the particular book and move it to a ‘shopping cart’ application. This software application then allows the customer to specify his/ her address for book delivery, the manner by which the payment has to be made, and how the delivery should be made. Upon submitting the order, an email message and an SMS message is sent to the customer to confirm the order. Subsequently, the site sends out messages informing the customer of when the order is dispatched and when it will be delivered. Once the online order is placed, the book is taken out of the Flipkart inventory, maintained at its offices and shipped to the customer. In case the ordered book is not available with Flipkart, it is purchased from a supplier and shipped immediately. Flipkart currently has partnerships with many courier companies, and also owns a shipping firm, called Ekart. It also uses the Indian post services to reach areas which are beyond the reach of courier companies. In this way it can maintain a prompt delivery service, which is a competitive need of the company. Flipkart started a cash on delivery’ service in many cities, the metros and tier one cities.
